This topic is part of the AQA A-Level PE specification.

Sport and Society appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Sport and Society in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Sport and Society.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
